name: Precedent
tagline: How comparable projects really performed, and where yours stands, in 24 to 48 hours.
problem: Nobody knows quickly whether a number is credible against what similar projects achieved.
how: Places them against comparable completed projects
A credibility check and a scope-gap list in 24 to 48 hours
features: Reference performance: Cost, schedule and root causes across comparable projects
Benchmarking: The estimate and schedule placed against the reference class
Peer benchmarking: Operating performance and value leakage against peers
What the best did: Practices that separated the best outcomes
Outside-in check: The estimate per kW against comparable plants by approval year
Package split check: Each package’s share of the estimate against public references
Scope-gap check: What comparable plants included that this estimate leaves out

screens.caption: The start of a Reality Scan: pick an industry, a single project or a company to test.

notes: This tool runs inside Project Intelligence Toolkit as Reality Scan. Only the start of a scan is shown: a finished scan needs a language model for its synthesis step, which this local run does not have.
